title: Miro board definition
description: YAML definition of a Miro board: frames with shapes, text, sticky notes, cards and connectors.

startX.description: x of the centre of the frames in column 0 (default 0).

rowSpacing.description: Distance from the centre of one row of frames to the centre of the next (default 1400). Not the gap: use frame height plus gap, e.g. 1000 + 400 = 1400 for the default frame.

frameSpacing.description: Distance from the centre of one frame to the centre of the next in a row (default 1800). Not the gap: use frame width plus gap, e.g. 1600 + 200 = 1800 for the default frame. Frames of 3000 x 1800 need frameSpacing of at least 3000 and rowSpacing of at least 1800.

layout.description: Where frames go on the board: frame centre x = startX + col * frameSpacing, y = row * rowSpacing.

colors.description: Named colors that elements can reference

phases.description: Optional session phases; a frame with `phase: <key>` gets a badge

headerBar.description: Add a title bar to every frame (default true)

parentElements.description: Make elements children of their frame (default false). With false, moving a frame in Miro leaves its elements where they are.

row.description: Row in the frame grid (default 0); centre y = row * layout.rowSpacing.

col.description: Column in the frame grid; centre x = layout.startX + col * layout.frameSpacing. Default: the frame's position in the frames list.

x.description: Absolute x of the frame centre on the board; overrides col.

y.description: Absolute y of the frame centre on the board; overrides row.

content.description: Text content; Miro accepts simple HTML

x.description: Centre of the element as an offset from the frame centre, in board units; positive is right. A 1600 x 1000 frame spans x from -800 to 800.

y.description: Centre of the element as an offset from the frame centre; positive is down. A 1600 x 1000 frame spans y from -500 to 500, and the top 60 units are the title bar.

shape.description: Miro shape name, e.g. rectangle, round_rectangle, circle, triangle, rhombus

color.description: Fill color: hex, Miro color name or a key of `colors`

toX.description: line only: horizontal distance from the start point (x) to the end point. Relative, not an absolute position: a line from x: -600 to x: 600 has toX: 1200.

toY.description: line only: vertical distance from the start point (y) to the end point. Relative, not an absolute position: a vertical line has toX: 0.
